name: Bholu
story: Bholu loves long walks and greets every visitor with a wagging tail. He walks well on a lead and is calm around children.

name: Mitthu
story: Mitthu is a talkative ginger cat who purrs the moment she is picked up. She would suit a calm home with a window to watch.

name: Rani
special_needs: Healing a leg wound; needs rest and a daily dressing.
story: Rani was brought in after a road accident. Her wound is healing well and she is learning to trust the staff.

name: Tiger
story: Tiger is staying with a foster family while he waits for a permanent home. He is learning basic commands and loves a game of fetch.

name: Moti
story: Moti found her family in October and now spends her afternoons on the sofa.

name: Kalu
story: Kalu was sterilised and vaccinated, then returned to the lane where he has lived for years. His ear is notched so he is easy to recognise.

name: Sheru
special_needs: Mild stiffness in the hind legs; a ground-floor home is best.
story: Sheru arrived in the rain, thin and frightened, and hid under a table for two days. Staff started calling him "the shadow" because he followed them quietly from room to room. Slowly he began to trust people, and now he leans against anyone who sits down beside him. He doesn't bark much, loves a slow evening walk, and takes treats very gently from an open hand. Sheru would suit a patient family who can give him a quiet routine, a soft bed and plenty of company. He has been with the centre for several months and has become a favourite with the volunteers, who say he is the calmest dog they have ever met.

name: Billo
special_needs: Recovering from a respiratory infection; kept in a quiet room.
story: Billo was found shivering outside a shop. He is eating well again and will be ready to meet visitors soon.

name: Simba
story: Profile awaiting approval by the centre.

name: Gudiya
story: Gudiya is the centre's unofficial welcome committee, first to the gate every morning.

name: Pappu
story: Pappu has endless energy and loves water. He needs an active family and some patient training.

name: Laddoo
story: Laddoo naps in sunny spots and puts up with being carried like a sack of flour. A very easy cat.

name: Champa
story: Champa was part of a neighbourhood sterilisation drive and is back in her lane, ear notched and vaccinated.

name: Bruno
special_needs: Senior dog; needs soft bedding and a gentle diet.
story: Bruno was found wandering near a highway. He is slow on stairs but loves company and slow walks.

name: Jalebi
story: Jalebi was found alone in a drain pipe and is now growing fast in foster care.

name: Raja
story: Raja is a calm, watchful dog who does best as an only pet.

name: Munni
story: Munni is small, brave and always the first to make friends.

name: Choco
story: Choco left for his new home in September and is now settling in on a sunny balcony.

name: Tommy
story: Tommy was vaccinated and sterilised during a camp and returned to his home area.

name: Pinky
story: Pinky now lives with a retired couple who say she supervises the garden.

name: Golu
story: Golu is a bundle of energy who is learning to walk on a lead.

name: Bunty
special_needs: Needs a quiet home and a fresh vegetable diet.
story: Bunty was handed in when his family moved house, and is being fostered while a permanent home is found.

name: Gabbar
special_needs: Recovering from tick fever; on medication.
story: Gabbar looks tough but melts when his ears are scratched. He is being treated and will be ready for adoption soon.
